{{Quote|Six-Two: The heart and soul of your team.|Taun We to [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]]|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
'''Scorch'''&mdash;who was also known by the designations '''RC-1262''', '''Delta-62''', and, later as part of the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], '''IC-1262'''&mdash;was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Born in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] on the [[Water/Legends|watery]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Scorch was trained by the Mandalorian ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Walon Vau]] to become a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Together with three other [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], Scorch was a part of the elite [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit, [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], and served as the [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] demolition and explosives expert. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|broke out]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Scorch took his place in the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Arligan Zey]], and served alongside his clone brothers in [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] on a number of battlefields, ranging from the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|the halls]] of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|RAS]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'', and [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|the streets]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to snowy [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] and the [[Battle of Haurgab|plains]] of [[Haurgab]]. A habitual joker, Scorch was never short of a clever wisecrack, even in the midst of battle, and oftentimes served to lighten the spirits of his squadmates.

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Scorch and the other members of Delta Squad—minus [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], who the squad was forced to [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|abandon]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the final days of the Clone Wars—served in the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], as members of the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], a specialized unit within the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] tasked with hunting down [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Desertion|deserters]], [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|fugitive]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sympathizers.

==Biography==
===Early life and training===
{{Quote|Minor burns and injuries incurred today during anti-armor weapons training with RC-1262. New nickname: 'Scorch.' |RC Batch Delta: Report: W Vau, Training Sergeant|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:ScorchThumbsup.png|thumb|left|200px|Scorch on Kamino]]
RC-1262 was born in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], in the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[Clone military education complex|facilities]] of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], on the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], RC-1262 was created to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] and was placed under the training of the Mandalorian ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Walon Vau]].<ref name="RepCom" /> RC-1262 earned the nickname of "Scorch" after an accident involving explosive ordnance left both himself and Vau without eyebrows for a period of [[Time/Legends|time]]. Scorch was assigned to [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], one of the first [[Commando/Legends|commando]] units established by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]], along with, [[RC-1140/Legends|RC-1140 "Fixer,"]] and [[Sev/Legends|RC-1207 "Sev"]], and under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|RC-1138 "Boss"]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> His weapon of choice: the [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m anti-armor attachment]]. Scorch's talent with explosives soon earned him the position of ''de facto'' explosives technician within Delta Squad,<ref name="TCSWE" /> and his jovial personality led the Kaminoan project coordinator for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] clone [[Army/Legends|army]], [[Taun We/Legends|Taun We]], to regard Scorch as the "[[Heart/Legends|heart]] and [[Soul/Legends|soul]]" of the squad.<ref name="RepCom" />

===Geonosis===
{{Quote|Now that you've disabled the anti-air turret, we're making a supply drop near your current position. Keep an eye out for it. Payload includes a special anti-armor attachment for your DC-17. You're going to need it.''"<br />"''Yes! More explosives! You just made my day, Advisor.|Advisor 01/425 and Scorch|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
The Grand Army would finally see action in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] took the army to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to rescue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Scorch and the rest of Delta Squad would be sent to Geonosis in a deployment so hastily ordered and carried out that it would leave Delta with no time to say goodbye to their training sergeant, Vau.<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> Delta Squad was tasked with [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Sun Fac/Legends|Sun Fac]]. The four commandos split up, each boarding a single [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] independently, with the intention of rendezvousing once on the surface of Geonosis.<ref name="RepCom" /> Scorch was the first to meet up with Delta Squad's sergeant, Boss, and the two made their way to the rendezvous together, picking up Fixer along the way and reuniting with Sev, who was already there and waiting. Together, Delta Squad attacked Sun Fac in his command center, although the Geonosian leader would manage to flee and escape. Delta tracked Fac through the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|Geonosian catacombs]], eventually catching up with him in Fac's private [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] as the Geonosian attempted to escape in [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|his starfighter]]. However, Fac's escape was prevented by the timely actions of Sev, who used the [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniping]] attachment of his [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] to shoot down the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] Fac.<ref name="RepCom" /> Scorch and the other members of Delta Squad were then tasked by [[Advisor/Legends|clone advisor]] [[01/425]] to complete the failed objective of their fellow Republic commando squad, [[Theta Squad]]: destroying an underground [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid factory]]. The commandos infiltrated the factory and targeted weak points in the facilities design, together causing enough damage to destroy it.<ref name="RepCom" />

[[File:Delta_Squad.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Scorch and Delta Squad in the heat of battle]]

Following the destruction of the droid factory, Delta Squad was given new orders, tasked with the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|infiltration]] of a [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]]. Deployed in a nearby canyon from an LAAT/i gunship [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Delta 42]], Delta Squad made their way to the Core Ship, using a downed gunship's [[Composite-beam laser|composite-beam]] turrets to fend off enemy Geonosians along the way. As they continued toward the Core Ship, the squad was called upon to take out an [[Anti-aircraft cannon/Legends|anti-aircraft cannon]]. Scorch and the other commandos fought through a number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and their [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] counterparts, before finally destroying the large anti-aircraft emplacement. When the squad finally reached the Core Ship, they were met with resistance from an [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid|advanced spider droid]], and a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] blocking the ship's entrance. The four commandos were able to destroy the spider droid with considerable effort and they then called in air-support to blow through the ray shielded entrance.<ref name="RepCom" /> Once inside, Delta Squad again split up, each of its members sabotaging and destroying various crucial systems; Scorch targeted the Core Ship's coolant intake valve. Scorch and Fixer came under heavy fire from a small number of [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], but were aided by the arrival of Sev and Boss. Their primary objective, however, was the capture of vital launch codes housed on the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. Once on the bridge, Delta came under heavy fire from numerous battle droids and stationary [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]], but still managed to acquire the codes before retreating down a branching corridor. By this point in time, the squad's efforts to sabotage the Core Ship had come to full fruition, with several primary systems overloading. With no time to make an escape back the way they had come, Delta Squad was extracted via LAAT/i gunship through a hole forcefully blown in the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ship.<ref name="RepCom" />

The Battle of Geonosis would be the first action Scorch and his brothers from Delta Squad would see, but with the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] breaking out throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], it would not be the last. Delta would prove to be one of the lucky minority of Republic commando squads to depart Geonosis intact and with no casualties; 4,982 other commandos perished on Geonosis' [[Color/Legends|red]] sands.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

===Mission to the ''Prosecutor''===
{{Dialogue|Advisor 01/425|We're sending our most qualified squad to investigate. Someone important noted your excellence on Geonosis.|Scorch|You hear that, Sev? Someone thinks ''I'm'' excellent.|Sev|Well...at least that makes ''two'' of you.|attr=Prior to the mission to the ''Prosecutor''|src=<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:Delta62.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Scorch, in his custom-painted Katarn armor]]
One day before the second anniversary of the Battle of Geonosis, three hundred and sixty-seven days into the Clone Wars, Scorch and the rest of Delta Squad were called upon to [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|investigate]] the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], ''[[Prosecutor]]''. Having recently reappeared in the [[Chaykin Cluster]] following a two-[[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long disappearance while tasked with defending [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], the ''Prosecutor'' was found drifting, without power or communication capability. Delta Squad had spent a substantial amount of time aboard the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] during the early portion of the war, even coming to think of it as their "first home". Arriving on scene in the [[Corbantis system/Legends|Corbantis system]] aboard a [[CR25 troop carrier/Legends|CR25 troop carrier]], Delta Squad was tasked with retrieving flight records from the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} four [[Datacore/Legends|data cores]] and securing the derelict [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]]; Scorch was charged with acquiring the data from the ship's starboard data core.<ref name="RepCom" />

The four members of Delta Squad disembarked from the CR25 via a jump through the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], splitting up and entering the ''Prosecutor'' at four different locations. Interference in their [[Comm unit/Legends|comms]] would quickly cut Sev and the others off from the guidance of 01/425, who was again serving as mission advisor to the squad. While searching through the ship, Delta Squad came across few survivors, and several members were set upon by [[Salvage droid/Legends|scavenger droids]]; Scorch was ambushed and incapacitated by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Shortly after, the squad found that the ''Prosecutor'' has been attacked by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and [[Trandoshan Elites|mercenaries]] when Sev was captured at the starboard data core. He was beaten and interrogated by the Trandoshans before Boss and Fixer were able to battle their way through heavily armed and [[Armor/Legends|armored]] Trandoshan [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to rescue Sev. Once Sev was free, the still incomplete squad moved to retrieve Scorch from where he was being held in the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} [[detention area]]. After a brief skirmish in the detention area, Delta Squad was able to locate and revive an incapacitated Scorch, and together make their way to the bridge where they destroyed a Confederacy [[Jammer/Legends|jamming device]] and re-established communication with their advisor.<ref name="RepCom" />

A brief [[Scanner|scan]] revealed that a [[Trandoshan dropship]] had touched down in one of the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} hangar bays. Proceeding to the hangar—after being sidetracked through the detention center by a booby-trapped [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]]—Scorch and the other members of Delta Squad found that a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] had entered the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and was rapidly approaching the ''Prosecutor''. While their advisor called for assistance, Delta Squad was charged with repelling the [[Battle droid dispenser|droid]] [[B2 battle droid dispenser|boarding]] [[Droideka dispenser|parties]] and sealing the assault ship's hangars. By the time Scorch and the others reached the final hangar, it was overrun with droids and the commandos had to resort to commandeering the roof-mounted [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]] of an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] to deal with the droid threat. Following these losses, the Separatist [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] opened fire on the ''Prosecutor'', deciding to cut its losses and destroy the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]] before reinforcements could arrive. In an attempt to hold off the battleship, Delta Squad struggled to get the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} turbolaser battery array back online amidst a continuing assault from droid forces already onboard. Reinforcements would come in the form of [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Talbot]] and the RAS [[Arrestor (Acclamator-class)|''Arrestor'']], the only Republic force to respond to 01/425's calls for assistance. Between the combined strength of the ''Arrestor'' and ''Prosecutor''—even as the latter's hull integrity was compromised—the Confederacy [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|droid control ship]] was destroyed, shutting down the battle droids aboard the ''Prosecutor'', and saving the ship and the lives of Delta Squad. Scorch and his Delta Squad brothers were commended by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] for their actions aboard the ''Prosecutor'', and the data that they retrieved would help enable the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] to better combat Trandoshan slaving operations in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="RepCom" />

===Combating terrorism===
[[File:Delta_Squad1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Scorch and Delta Squad]]
{{Quote|Scorch, sooner rather than later, okay?''"<br />"''One minute, tops.''"<br />"''We haven't ''got'' a minute—''"<br />"''What d'you want me to do, chew through it?|Boss and Scorch, during the extraction of Omega Squad|<ref name="TZ" />}}
Scorch and the rest of Delta Squad departed the ''Prosecutor'' aboard a captured [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Shortly thereafter, they received a [[Red Zero]] signal—the GAR code requesting immediate extraction—from their fellow commando unit, [[Omega Squad]]. Delta Squad was closest Republic unit to Omega's position aboard a [[Gizer L-6 freighter|damaged]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] at the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian]]&ndash;[[Perlemian node|Perlemian]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] intersection, in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]], and the first on sight to recover both their commando comrades and [[M'truli|the trio]] [[Gysk|of]] [[Farr Orjul|prisoners]] Omega Squad had [[Mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Intersection|apprehended]]. Scorch deployed from the captured shuttle, and cut through the forward [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] of Omega's freighter before attaching a docking tube that allowed his fellow commandos and their terrorist captives to cross-deck to Delta's vessel. Once safely back on board, both Delta and Omega Squad docked aboard the ''Acclamator''-class ship, ''[[Fearless]]'', and returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TZ" />

On Coruscant, Scorch and the other Delta Squad members were recruited by the former ''Cuy'val Dar'' sergeant [[Kal Skirata]] for a [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|black ops mission]] to be conducted on Coruscant itself. In the days and [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] prior, Coruscant had suffered a number of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] attacks on [[Depot Bravo Five|GAR facilities]], and Skirata had devised a means of covertly striking back at the terrorists culprits. Together with Omega Squad, Delta's former trainer Walon Vau, the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]] and [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]], and Jedi Generals [[Bardan Jusik]] and [[Etain Tur-Mukan]], Scorch and the rest of Delta Squad began an investigation into the terrorists whereabouts from the seedy [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-owned [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], [[Qibbu's Hut/Legends|Qibbu's Hut]], in Coruscant's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]. Despite a grudge between Delta Squad's Sev and Omega Squad member, [[Atin Skirata|Atin]], the two squads grew to respect each other. Using [[Qibbu]] the Hutt's criminal contacts, the counter-terrorist strike team was able to lure their targets under the pretense of having a supply of high yield thermal [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] explosive that they were willing to sell. While Skirata acted as the strike team's public face, meeting with members of the terror cell—including its leader, [[Perrive]]—Scorch and Sev teamed with Omega Squad's [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] and [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] to mark the terrorists with [[Dust|specially designed tracers]] using Skirata's personally owned [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Verpine shatter gun|sniper rifles]]. After a meeting between Skirata and the terrorist leader Perrive establishing a time when they would supposedly make the explosives sale, Delta Squad spent an evening enjoying themselves at Qibbu's bar with the other member's of the strike team, at least until the revelry was cut short by a call from Perrive stating they would need to move up their time and change the pre-established location. Fortunately, the new location for the trade was a [[CoruFresh]] produce distribution depot in [[Quadrant F-76]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], a location Delta Squad had personally reconnoitered earlier.<ref name="TZ" />

The squad split up upon arrival, Boss and Scorch stayed together, covering the depot's landing strip while Sev partnering with Ordo, and Fixer with Atin. Once Skirata and Jusik passed the explosives off to the terrorists and cleared the area as planned, the assembled troops struck, shutting off the lights and attacking from every direction, including the roof. Delta Squad neutralized the terrorists who fled into the repulsor truck they had loaded the explosives in, ensuring that there would be no desperate suicidal detonation. A grenade strike nearly wounded Scorch, but Delta's demolitions man escaped only shaken. Once the terrorists were dead, Scorch and the others returned to Qibbu's for a final night, and then attended an evening as guests of the [[Coruscant Security Force Staff and Social Club|CSF Social Club]]. But just six days later, Delta Squad was back on assignment, shipped off to [[Skuumaa]] and tasked with battlefield preparation consisting of sabotaging strategic targets ahead of the main Republic assault.<ref name="TZ" />

===Mission to Devaron===
[[File:DeltaSquad-WOTM.png|thumb|right|250px|Delta Squad returns from Devaron]]
{{Quote|There were no survivors on Devaron. Everyone was killed, including Master Halsey and his Padawan.|Boss, reporting on the fate of Halsey|<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>}}
Scorch and the clone commandos of Delta Squad were later dispatched to the planet [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] in the aftermath of an [[Devaron massacre/Legends|attack]] by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. The squad attempted to locate any survivors of the massacre outside of the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]], but found only corpses. They recovered the bodies of Jedi Master [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] and his Padawan [[Knox/Legends|Knox]] and returned them to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant where they reported their findings to members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="Witches of the Mist" />

===Mygeeto===
{{Quote|You're conspicuous in that black armor, Sarge. It's worse than having Omega alongside. What say you back out of here and leave me to hold them?''"<br />"''Humor an old man. I stop the droids, you pick off the wets. Then we ''all'' run for it. Deal?|Scorch and Walon Vau during their escape from the Dressian Kiolsh bank|<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
[[File:DeltaSquad_RCcover.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Scorch with Boss and Sev]]
Four hundred and seventy days after Geonosis, Delta Squad had been sent to the Outer Rim world of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]. The squad was tasked with calling in air strikes and sabotaging Mygeetan ground defenses near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jygat]] in preparation for [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bacara/Legends|Bacara]] and the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines']] [[Battle of Mygeeto|main assault]]. Delta completed their assignments as ordered, but instead of exfiltrating as they were supposed to, Scorch and the other commandos instead decided to assist their former training sergeant Vau in his personal mission, one that consisted of robbing Mygeeto's own [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank]]. Scorch broke into the main [[Safe|vault]], while Boss and Sev stood nearby and Fixer kept a look out from their [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] on the surface. Once inside, Vau refused to allow the squad to assist him any further in the heist, determined not to compromise his trainees' integrity by directly involving them in the actual act of stealing. It was during Vau's raid on the vault's numerous safety deposit boxes that Scorch learned of his former training sergeant's past as a disinherited [[Count of Gesl|aristocrat]] from [[Irmenu]], and that the purpose of the theft was to regain the inheritance his [[Walon Vau's mother|mother]] and [[Walon Vau's father|father]] had denied him. When Vau ordered Delta to leave him and continue on with their assigned mission, however, the squad refused—reminding Vau that he was no longer a sergeant, just a civilian—and instead assisted Vau and his [[Strill/Legends|strill]], [[Lord Mirdalan]], carry the stolen loot out of the bank.<ref name="TC" />

Their exit would become complicated when one of the bank's alarms was triggered, and although Fixer brought the snowspeeder closer to the extraction point, Delta and Vau would have to fight their way through an armed patrol of [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] and battle droids to escape. During the skirmish, Vau fell through a hole in the ice and into one of the countless [[Whiteworm/Legends|crystal-worm]] tunnels that ran beneath the frozen surface of Mygeeto; although Delta Squad was determined to retrieve him, Vau forcefully commanded them to leave him and get themselves to safety. Despite severe reservations, Delta Squad did as ordered and exfiltrated from Mygeeto, although each would have some difficulty coming to terms with their perceived abandonment of their former sergeant. However, Boss contacted Kal Skirata and Null [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] Ordo once they were off planet to inform them of Vau's situation; Skirata and Ordo immediately traveled to Mygeeto and managed to extract a [[Hypothermia/Legends|hypothermic]] but still alive Vau from beneath the Mygeetan ice. Sev would still look upon the incident as a personal failure, believing he let his old sergeant down, but Scorch took it upon himself to attempt to cheer up his brother.<ref name="TC" />

===Hunting Ko Sai===
{{Quote|Wow, this is amazing. Look at ''that!''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''It's a fish, Scorch. You'll get over it. So will the fish.''"<br />"''Come on, how many folks get to do this? Savor the privilege, man.''"<br />"''I will, next time I'm getting my ''shebs'' shot off.|Scorch and Sev, during their first underwater experience in a real ocean|<ref name="TC" />}}
Upon their return to Coruscant from Mygeeto, Delta Squad was debriefed by the [[Director of Special Forces]], Jedi General Arligan Zey, at [[Special Operations Brigade Headquarters]]. Zey then informed Delta of their newest orders: [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had ordered the capture of the rogue [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], Kamino's own former [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]]. Considering her capture as near a priority as locating the Confederacy's [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], General Grievous—if only to deny her expertise to the Separatists, but primarily so as to have an [[Clone Master/Legends|experienced cloner]] unassociated with Tipoca under Republic control—Palpatine insisted that Zey put his most qualified squad on the assignment, from which Zey selected Delta Squad for the task. Ko Sai had gone missing during the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]], and was suspected to have [[Desertion|defected]] to the Confederacy by Kamino's [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]], [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]. Despite the length of time between her disappearance and Delta Squad's tasking of her retrieval, Kaminoan intelligence was able to track Ko Sai's movements to the planet [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]]. Zey insisted that Delta Squad not inform Kal Skirata of their assignment, knowing of the Mandalorian's extreme hate for Kaminoans. Unknown to Delta, Skirata was also already hunting for Ko Sai, but for his own reasons: he wished to use the Kaminoan scientist to find a way to halt the accelerating aging that plagued the Grand Army's millions of clones.<ref name="TC" />

[[File:DS_Scorch.png|thumb|right|190px|Scorch with his DC-17m blaster rifle]]
Delta Squad followed the Kaminoans' intelligence reports to Vaynai, and then on to [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]], and from there to [[Napdu]], the fourth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the planet [[Da Soocha]], in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Files acquired from the [[Nar Hej Shipping Company]] on Napdu helped Delta to further trace a pattern of movement for Ko Sai, tracking her across the Outer Rim's numerous aquatic worlds toward the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]]. The squad came under attack from a [[Crusher-class starfighter|''Crusher''-class starfighter]] while leaving Napdu in one of the Grand Army's [[Traffic Interdiction Vessel|TIV]] vessels. They touched down on Da Soocha's [[Da Soocha III|third moon]], with the ''Crusher'' continuing pursuit; on the ground, Boss used the TIV's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] to blast away one of the ''Crusher''{{'s}} wings, and both Scorch and Sev attacked the wrecked starfighter. Though Sev killed the female pilot and her male copilot, Fixer was able to access the ship's computer and determine that the pair were bounty hunters hired by the Kaminoans to track Ko Sai.<ref name="TC" /> Using the data acquired from the Nar Hej Shipping Company, Delta Squad tracked down the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Leb Chura]], on [[Bogg 4]]. Deltas interrogated Chura as to Ko Sai's whereabouts with the assistance of General Bardan Jusik: Chura had been moving cloning materials from [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] to [[Dorumaa]], but the Twi'lek had already relayed this information to Skirata and Vau. In order to keep Skirata and his quest a secret, Jusik [[Mind trick/Legends|influenced]] Chura to recall Mandalorians wearing [[Color/Legends|green]] armor instead of Skirata and Vau's more recognizable [[Gold/Legends|golden]] and black sets when asked, and upon learning that Chura had delivered the consignment to a location near Dorumaa's [[Tropix Island Resort]], Jusik [[Memory rub/Legends|erased]] the pilot's memory of both Delta and Skirata's band, along with deleting the records on his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]; Delta chalked Jusik's odd behavior up to Jedi eccentricities.<ref name="TC" />

In spite of this, Delta acquired [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|SCUBA trooper]] armor and traveled to the [[Tropix Resorts|resort]] world of Dorumaa. There, Delta acted as part of a utilities maintenance crew in order to gather surveillance which led them to a collapsed area underneath Tropix's neighboring [[ActionWorld]] island. Upon investigating—diving underwater in an experience that Scorch found to be amazing—the squad found the [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal]] remains of a dead human that had been [[Chain (droid)|chained]] beneath the water, and the collapsed entrance to the facility that had previously belonged to Ko Sai. Skirata and his crew had arrived first, capturing the Kaminoan scientist, destroying the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], and taking her back to [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Skirata's home]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The squad was tasked with the slow excavation of the area; at one point they were able to insert a small [[strip-cam]] through an available opening, finding the armored remains of the Mandalorian bodyguards Ko Sai had hired. Though Delta found no further evidence over the next few weeks of excavation, they remained unyieldingly loyal in covering for General Jusik's absence while the Jedi Knight secretly sneaked away to aid Skirata. Five hundred and forty-eight days into the Clone Wars, the commandos of Delta Squad were called back to Special Operations Brigade on Coruscant where they were met by Kal Skirata. There, Skirata gave Sev a package containing Ko Sai's severed head to deliver to General Zey; the rogue Kaminoan had taken her own life while being held on Mandalore, and was cut into pieces post-mortem.<ref name="TC" />

===Wearying warfare===
{{Quote|It's not right. Clones shouldn't mix with officers. Let alone ''Jedi'' officers.''"<br />"''What, in case we get ideas above our station? Don't know our place, die nice and quietly so we don't upset the civvies?''"<br />"''You spend too long talking to Fi and those Null dingbats, Scorch.''"<br />"''You've seen the average galactic citizen now. We didn't know any better on Kamino. If anyone's superior, it's ''us'', not them.|Fixer and Scorch|<ref name="O66" />}}
[[File:Commando_1c.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Scorch and his brothers Boss and Sev]]
Seven hundred and thirty-six days after the Battle of Geonosis—on the second anniversary of the start of the Clone Wars—Delta Squad was stationed at [[Arca Company Barracks]] on Coruscant awaiting assignment. There, Scorch discreetly spied on a meeting of ''Cuy'val Dar'' sergeants Kal Skirata and Walon Vau on the [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] parade ground. Though Sev was initially uninterested—preferring to instead discuss Ko Sai and the possible accelerated aging cure Skirata was after for the clones while enjoying some [[Spice/Legends|spiced]] [[warra nut]]s—he soon joined Scorch and found the two Mandalorians were engaged in reciting the names of fallen clone commandos in the Mandalorian custom for honoring dead comrades and loved ones. Both Scorch and Sev joined the two sergeants in the commemoration ritual, along with a number of other commandos who joined in as the list of names went on. When they reached the list's end, Skirata took the time to say a few encouraging words to the assembled soldiers, and wished them all to stay safe so that they might be able to see his [[Venku Skirata|young grandson]] grow up. As the crowd dispersed, Scorch kept an eye on his former training sergeant long enough to see Vau and Skirata meeting with fellow former Mandalorian ''Cuy'val Dar'' trainers [[Mij Gilamar]] and [[Wad'e Tay'haai]] for reasons unknown to the clone commando.<ref name="O66" />

Several months later, approximately nine hundred and seventy days into the war, Delta Squad found themselves on the Separatist-aligned [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet of [[Haurgab]]. Originally, while Jedi General [[Mlaske]] and the Grand Army's [[85th Infantry Brigade]] were already [[Battle of Haurgab|operating]] on Haurgab, the only Republic commando presence on the dusty backwater world had been Omega Squad, sent to assassinate a [[Jolluc|key leader]] of the pro-Separatist [[Maujasi]]. However, as time passed, the Republic began to assign more and more Grand Army forces to Haurgab and Delta Squad, much to their displeasure, soon joined them. Scorch and the other three members of Delta Squad ate with a number of other clone troops in the mess hall of the [[Hadde Base|Republic's base]] on the outskirts of the Haurgab city of [[Hadde]], during a field visit from [[Commando Group]] [[Zero Five Commando]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], General Etain Tur-Mukan. While Delta was sitting down at a table with their food—and Scorch expressing some of his growing dissatisfaction with his life in the Grand Army—the base was struck by a [[Huntmaster missile|missile]] from within the city limits; though numerous troopers were killed and wounded in the attack both from the blast and the resultant shrapnel, Delta Squad had been spared the worst injuries thanks to their hardy ''Katarn'' armor—Scorch was thrown backward and the table blown on top of him. The shock of being attacked in a place that had always been perceived as safe and the sight of so many dead and injured clones drove the normally lighthearted Scorch into a rage: together with Omega Squad, General Tur-Mukan, and elements of the 85th and [[14th Infantry Brigade]]s, Scorch and Delta Squad struck back hard against the rebel forces. When they had arrived at the house where the missile had originated, Scorch insisted on being part of the assault team for the raid while the rest of Delta stood by as security to deal with any potential attack from another source. Omega Squad's Darman blew open the door with a [[breaching grenade]], and Scorch lobbed another grenade through the blasted-open entrance before following Atin and [[Corr Skirata|Corr]]—Omega Squad's replacement for Fi, following a traumatic brain injury during a [[Battle of Gaftikar|mission]] to [[Gaftikar]]—into the house. During the shootout, four rebels were taken captive, while another three were killed. Death would prove not to be enough for Scorch, however: the infuriated commando dragged the rebels' lifeless bodies out into the street where he riddled them with blasterfire before finally spitting on each of the charred corpses. General Tur-Mukan made a point of speaking with Scorch afterward, offering to ease his mind with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="O66" />

===Kashyyyk===
{{Quote|I'm not leaving him, Boss. You go if you want to. Not me.''"<br />"''This is an ''order''.''"<br />"''Screw orders. Omega wouldn't leave a man.''"<br />"''Scorch&hellip;''"<br />"''You'll have to shoot me.''"<br />"''Losing one guy is bad enough. I'm not losing two. Don't let me down now. Shift it, Six-Two.''"<br />"''I'll never forgive you for this, Boss. Or you, Fixer. We're ''brothers'', for fierfek's sake. I'd never leave you.|Scorch and Boss, following an evac order after Sev loses contact under fire|<ref name="O66" />}}
[[File:LAATiDeltaSquad-RC.png|thumb|right|250px|Delta Squad inserting on Kashyyyk]]
Around one thousand and seventy days after the Battle of Geonosis,<ref name="O66" /> Delta Squad was sent to the Wookiee homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. Following a Separatist-backed invasion by Trandoshan slavers, the Wookiee [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] had been taken prisoner. Tarfful had spent years combating Trandoshan slaving parties, and without him the Wookiees turned to the Republic for assistance. In response, Delta Squad was [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|deployed]] to Kashyyyk in order to extract Tarfful from captivity. Scorch and the rest of Delta Squad covertly inserted into Kashyyyk via LAAT/i gunship, [[Rappel line|rappelling]] down to the planet's surface from the troop bay. Battling their way through the Trandoshan slaver camp, Delta freed a number of other Wookiee captives before rescuing Tarfful from the clutches of General Grievous himself. Defeating two of the general's [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], Delta Squad's assault prompted Grievous to flee Kashyyyk aboard his personal starfighter.<ref name="RepCom" />

Delta Squad destroyed another Trandoshan encampment not long after, before moving on to the [[Kachirho Bridge|bridge]] near the Wookiee village of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]].<ref name="RepCom" /> By this point in time, Delta had been joined by Jedi General Etain Tur-Mukan on order of General Arligan Zey, who believed that she would prove beneficial to the mission. She informed the squad of the bridge's significance — were the bridge to be destroyed, the Separatist supply lines would be cut off, while the Wookiees would be able to construct smaller bridges to circumvent the loss, an option the Confederacy's battle droids didn't have — and tasked the squad with taking it out.<ref name="O66" /> Moving through an occupied market concourse, Delta fought their way through numerous Trandoshan grenadiers and heavily armed mercenaries along with another advanced spider droid and countless battle droids to reach the [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] [[Kachirho Bridge|Bridge]], where Delta Squad placed a [[detonation pack]] at the center of the bridge where it was weakest. However, when Boss attempted to detonate the charge, the explosives suffered a misfire.<ref name="RepCom" /> Undeterred, Scorch borrowed a [[Wookiee Guided Rocket Launcher|rocket launcher]] from a female Wookiee, and used it to destroy the bridge.<ref name="O66" /> Thirteen days later, Delta would continue operations on Kashyyyk, even as Coruscant came [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|under attack]] by General Grievous. While preparing to ambush a Separatist droid patrol, Scorch and Sev listened in to the comlink traffic from Coruscant, learning that only commandos in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] had received the [[Code Five]] signal to return to Coruscant immediately. When General Tur-Mukan expressed her concern for her loved ones residing on the Republic's besieged capital, Delta Squad took it upon themselves to comfort her, and when she revealed that she had a [[Venku Skirata|son]], they promised to keep her secret. Though the battle droid patrol would fall victim to Wookiee-make pitfalls, Delta and Tur-Mukan ambushed a small group of Trandoshans scouting through the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]], disposing of their dead bodies via a carnivorous plant.<ref name="O66" />

[[File:RC-TripleZero_cover.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Scorch with the other members of Delta Squad]]
Five days later, with the crisis on Coruscant over, Delta Squad was joined on Kashyyyk by the clone forces of Jedi General [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], arriving from [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]]. In addition, General Yoda was inbound with the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Legion]] and Wookiee Chieftain Tarfful, set to land within thirty standard minutes. However, a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] had taken up position to engage Yoda's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and halt the debarking of additional ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. With a bit of good-natured coaxing from General Tur-Mukan, Delta Squad infiltrated a Separatist turbolaser battery complex with the intent to commandeer the contained firepower to take out the ''Recusant''-class [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]]. With Clone Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] considering alternative landing sites—each too far removed from the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|main offensive]] to be effective—Delta Squad captured one [[Wookiee dual missile turret]] for each commando, and opened fire on the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] destroyer, joined in the attack by a [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of General Vos' LAAT/i gunships. After sustaining heavy damage, the Recusant destroyer began to fall, but while the majority of Delta Squad planned for a hasty exit, Sev radioed in with a report of coming under attack from multiple hostiles. When Boss ordered the squad to go back for Sev, Vos' [[Forward Air Controller/Legends|Forward Air Controller]] instead ordered Delta to leave, stating that the order had come directly from General Yoda himself. Though Scorch argued to the point of tears, Boss forced him to comply and moved the remaining three members of Delta Squad onto the gunship that had arrived to extract them, but not without first making a guilty apology to Sev.<ref name="O66" /> Onboard the gunship, Advisor 01/425 confronted the squad via hologram and ordered them to get under control. When he stated that the loss of a single commando was acceptable in the course of a major operation, Scorch lashed out, declaring that Sev was his ''brother''. The advisor then patched through a transmission from General Yoda, who stated that Delta Squad's efforts had enabled the Republic to establish forward command in Kachirho, and then retasked Delta with a new set of objectives for Kashyyyk.<ref name="RepCom" />

===Imperial service===
{{Quote|I ''hate'' this. And we've got some new guy taking Sev's place. It's temporary, though. He'd better understand that.|Scorch, on his new life as an Imperial Commando|<ref name="ImpCom501st" />}}
Not long after the conclusion of Republic action on Kashyyyk and the issuing of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which branded the Jedi traitors to the Republic who were to be shot on sight, the Clone Wars would come to an end when the old Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], under the leadership of the now [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine. Nearly eleven-hundred days after the Battle of Geonosis, the three remaining members of Delta Squad found themselves stationed at the [[Imperial Army Training Center]] on [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]], one of the moons of Coruscant and the location of the secret [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]-based [[Clone trooper/Legends#Palpatine.27s_Secret_Army|second clone army]] that Palpatine had created. There, they would continue to lament the loss of Sev, especially in the face of the revelation that although Omega Squad members Atin and Corr had deserted the Grand Army, Darman and Niner had joined Delta in the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] because Darman had refused to leave a [[Skirmish on Shinarcan Bridge Extension|badly wounded]] Niner behind on his own.<ref name="O66" /> Three weeks after the formation of the new Empire, Delta Squad—with a new replacement for Sev among their ranks whom Scorch held a measure of resentment toward—gathered at the [[501st Legion headquarters]] on Coruscant with a number of other former Republic commandos and Advanced Recon Commandos for an audience with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. There, Vader reformed the Republic's former [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] soldiers as the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], an elite unit within the Imperial [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] that would be tasked with hunting down Jedi who managed to escape Order 66, along with clone deserters, Jedi sympathizers, and other Imperial dissidents. Their serial numbers' "RC" prefix replaced with an "IC" to denote their new position as Imperial Commandos, the squad would also find themselves given a different and more numerically-based name, similar to the former Omega Squad being deemed "[[Squad 40]]."<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> Although initially under the command of the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Sa Cuis]], the Imperial Commando Special Unit would be taken over by Imperial Commander [[Roly Melusar]]—a native of the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and a man with a firm hatred of all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]—following [[Duel on Vohai|Cuis' death]]. Melusar's zealous hate for the Jedi and all other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|beings who could wield the Force]] that would lead Scorch to tag Melusar with the nickname of "Holy Roly", a name that would in fact stick among the ranks of the Imperial Commando Special Unit.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Scorch.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Scorch]]
{{Quote|Can't keep a good clone down, sir.|Scorch|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
Scorch was Delta Squad's lighthearted wise-cracker, and could often be counted on to crack a joke or poke fun at the situations the squad encountered. At the same time, he was also a competent soldier who served as Delta Squad's explosives technician, a job which he excelled at,<ref name="TCSWE" /> and one he thoroughly enjoyed.<ref name="RepCom" /> Scorch possessed an inflated sense of irony that some mistook as fatalism,<ref name="TCSWE" /> and spent much of his time verbally sparring with fellow squad member Sev, playfully maintaining a brotherly relationship of back-and-forth teasing and friendly rivalry.<ref name="RepCom" /> Scorch carried a large ordnance [[Backpack/Legends|pack]] strapped to his back and sported yellow-colored markings on his wrist [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]], making him easier to identify by his squadmates. His love of explosives also caused him to favor the anti-armor [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] [[Grenade launcher/Legends|launcher]] attachment for his DC-17 blaster rifle. He also had anti-armor shells strapped to his leg.<ref name="RepCom" /> Scorch was also fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], and could speak [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] near fluently.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
RC-1262—Scorch—made his first appearance in the the [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', where he was voiced by [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Raphael Sbarge]], who also previously voiced the ''[[Star Wars]]'' character [[Carth Onasi]] in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. Scorch would later feature in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] of novels by author [[Karen Traviss]], beginning with an appearance in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', and continuing in [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']], [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], and ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''.

Scorch was one of the four Delta Squad members that was captured in bust form by [[Gentle Giant Studios]]. All the busts are exclusive to one country across the whole world, and all have a limited edition of 1300 worldwide. The Scorch bust is exclusive in the United States, Boss exclusive in the Netherlands, Fixer in Japan, and Sev in the UK.
